children: The Ibovespa rose 0.5% to close at 205,430 on Friday, supported by fresh economic activity data and a slowdown in the oil rally.
The BCB’s Economic Activity Index rose 0.3% month-over-month in August, in line with market expectations and rebounding from a 0.2% decline in July.
Growth was supported by sectors geared toward the domestic economy, particularly those linked to household income, which benefited from slower price increases for essential goods such as food.
Utilities closed mostly higher, with Axia gaining 0.6% and Sabesp adding 1%.
Retailers and non-durable goods producers also advanced, with Ambev up 0.9% and Assaí rising 4.2%.
Meanwhile, Petrobras climbed 4% as oil prices remained elevated amid mounting supply risks linked to escalating tensions in the Middle East and between Russia and Ukraine.
On the week, the Ibovespa shed 0.5%.

title: Ibovespa Advances on IBC-Br Rebound
